rows.rationale: B commits to an art direction made for this brief: ruled ledger paper in sage and cream, heavy condensed headlines, folio numbering, a live journal table in the hero and a red 'ZERO' that carries through to the 0.00 trial balance, control register and full-bleed red sign-up band. A is a well-finished but familiar dark SaaS template (lime accent, italic serif emphasis, glass cards, giant footer wordmark) whose first viewport stays essentially empty until about 1.3 s and whose scroll frames at 675 px, 2025 px and 8100 px leave large dead areas. B's headline resolves line by line within about 850 ms, and its scroll shows more varied storytelling (pinned request/entries/settled ledger steps, word-by-word text highlight in security, horizontal customer slips, section colour changes) against A's single strong pinned payment-flow diagram. Hover feedback is clear on both (A: nav pill and button glow; B: underlines and a dark-to-red button flip) and both phone layouts hold up without clipping.

A has lush glowing product renders and strong pinned scroll scenes (rotating object, six-step exploded stack, acoustic heatmap, card rail), but its percentage preloader is still at 93% three seconds after navigation, so the desktop hero is never seen and the mobile first viewport is only the loader; its dark-amber look with italic serif accent words is also a familiar premium template. B resolves a sequenced entrance by about 1.3 s (dimension lines draw, the HALO wordmark rises, the speaker lands in front of it with callouts) and commits to an engineering-drawing art direction made for this brief: sheet numbering, Copenhagen coordinates, polar and in-room response plots, a room plan, district-named wool colourways and a full orange pre-order configurator. B's hovers are plainer (colour inversion, underlines) versus A's custom cursor ring and amber fill, and B leaves a sparse stretch beside the sticky speaker in Materials, but its phone layout is clean throughout and it reads as the more complete and distinctive site.

A is the more polished and better-choreographed site: a rising moon, a pinned phone that changes through three phases, and a status pill that runs from 9:41 PM to first light with a sunrise at the download section, but its headline flashes at 80 ms then goes blank until ~1.3 s, a few scroll frames are half-empty (5323, 6679), and the dark purple gradient, serif-italic accents, glass bento and pricing cards read as a familiar premium AI-app template. B is built around the brief: a contour-chart hero with a time axis and a 'bulletin for tonight', a hypnogram motif reused as logo, scroll-linked mix dashboard and testimonial signatures, a sleep-stage data table with citations, six real app screens, a comparison-table pricing layout and a wake-time calculator, across colour-blocked sections with wave dividers. B's weaknesses are a hero that is still blank at 80 ms and only starts revealing after 2 s, a desktop hero headline set in a plainer wide sans than the condensed face used elsewhere, a CTA that still looks greyed at 3 s, and a pink hypnogram line crossing the headline on mobile. B's hover states (pink fills, logo colour swap, underlines) are clearer than A's very subtle glows; B wins narrowly on originality and content design over A's finish and motion.

A commits to a sleep-chart art direction made for this brief: topographic 'chart of tonight' hero, a scroll-scrubbed hypnogram whose clock and mix levels change (22:00 to 02:44), a sleep-stage table, torn-wave section breaks across ice, royal blue, peach and cream, and hover states with clear colour swaps and underlines. B is polished and atmospheric, with a pinned phone that changes by phase, a night-clock pill running 9:41 PM to first light and a sunrise close, but its glass cards, bento grid, gradient-italic serif and giant footer wordmark read closer to a familiar dark premium template, and its hover feedback is barely visible. A loses points for a hero that stays blank for about 2 s with the CTA still faded at 3 s, and a pink hypnogram line crossing the headline on mobile; B flashes its headline at 80 ms before hiding and re-animating it, and leaves some empty bands mid-scroll. A's originality and stronger finish in the data sections outweigh its slow entrance.

A commits to an architectural drawing-set language made for this brief (line-drawn town-hall elevation that draws in under a staggered headline by 1.3 s, plate captions, tally-mark section numerals, an isometric frame that assembles into a clad red house across the pinned process section, a title-block footer) and every frame, hover state and phone viewport is complete and legible. B has the lusher imagery (aurora and sunset project posters, a horizontal work gallery, a staged site-plan drawing, wood-grain NORR footer lettering), but its desktop entrance sits on a preloader reading 000% for the whole capture (still stuck at ~5.7 s and in the 'after entrance' frame), so the hero is never seen on desktop and the phone's first viewport is also only the loader. B's custom cursor ring also covers the labels it hovers and the Enquire pill loses its text on hover, whereas A's inverted-fill and underline hovers are crisp and unambiguous.

A's desktop preloader sits at "000%" on a near-empty dark screen through every entrance frame (to ~5.7 s) and is still covering the page in the post-entrance top frame, so its hero is never seen on desktop and the phone's first viewport is likewise still the loader; B's red hero resolves cleanly by 1.3 s with a line-by-line headline reveal and a town-hall elevation that draws itself in. Below the fold A is the lusher site (illustrated project scenes in a horizontal gallery, a pinned site-plan drawing that builds stage by stage, wood-grain NORR footer), but B answers with an equally brief-specific drawing-sheet system: plate captions, section/elevation plates, a pinned isometric assembly that goes from frame to clad building, and a title-block footer, all consistently aligned on desktop and mobile. B's hover states are crisp inversions and underlines, whereas A's custom cursor ring obscures labels and the Enquire pill is captured as a blank cream fill with no visible text.

A commits to a ledger-paper art direction made for this brief: condensed display type sitting on ruled lines, folio-numbered sections, a live journal table, a control register and pricing set as a ledger, with one orange-red accent and a full-bleed orange sign-up close. Its headline lines mask-reveal in a staggered sequence that is complete by about 1.3 s, and the scroll adds a pinned request/entries/settled stepper, a word-by-word security statement and horizontally travelling customer slips. B is polished and has the richer single scene (the pinned payment-flow diagram with event stream, plus the region quorum graphic), but its dark background, lime accent, serif-italic emphasis word, bento cards and three-card pricing read as a familiar premium SaaS template. B's first viewport is also essentially blank for the first ~850 ms and shows headline and paragraph overlapping at 1.3 s, and its code panel leaves a large empty response area.

A commits to a technical-drawing art direction made for a Copenhagen audio object: a giant HALO wordmark behind the speaker with dimension callouts, 'sheet n of 7' section rules, polar and in-room response charts, a room plan and a bold orange pre-order close, and its entrance is fully choreographed and settled by about 1.3 s (leader lines draw, letters rise, speaker lifts in). B has lusher amber-lit renders, a pinned rotating object scene, a numbered exploded view and a draggable room heat-map, but its preloader is still at 93% at 3 s on desktop and its hero is never visible in the entrance or the first scroll frame, with the phone's first viewport also showing only the loader. B's dark-glow serif-italic styling also reads closer to a familiar premium template, while A's hover states (colour inversion, underline draw, logo fill) and mobile layout are clean and legible throughout.
